title: Teen Titans Go!
description: Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg return in all-new, comedic adventures. They may be super heroes who save the world every day … but somebody still has to do the laundry!

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x1
episodes_data.description: Beast Boy, Robin and Starfire go in search of the ingredients for a legendary sandwich.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x2
episodes_data.description: Robin's driving instructor is really a bank robber with a perfect getaway plan, while Raven warns the team that her demon father is coming to visit.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x3
episodes_data.description: Robin takes driver's ed, and his teacher has some tricks up his sleeve.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x4
episodes_data.description: Raven's dad cozies up to her friends in hopes of luring her over to the dark side.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x5
episodes_data.description: Cyborg has Raven create doubles of himself and Beast Boy.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x6
episodes_data.description: To go on a date with Starfire, Robin kidnaps Speedy.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x7
episodes_data.description: The gang try to teach Robin to relax after his high-strung nature begins affecting the team. Later, chores pile up while the team bicker, and soon their dirty uniforms go on the offensive.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x8
episodes_data.description: Later, chores pile up while the team bicker, and soon their dirty uniforms go on the offensive.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x9
episodes_data.description: Beast Boy pretends to be a ghost haunting Starfire so she will do his bidding. When she figures out the ruse, she and the other Titans convince Beast Boy that he's actually dead.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x10
episodes_data.description: Robin, Cyborg, Beast Boy, and Raven agree to take on the responsibility of babysitting Silkie while Starfire is away.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x11
episodes_data.description: Cyborg and Beast Boy try to capitalize on Zippy's Pizza's "thirty minutes or its free" deal, but the delivery boy is seemingly unstoppable. It becomes a bit of a challenge as an all-out war of wits between them erupts. Meanwhile, Robin struggles with whether to build a senior center or a pool (leaning toward the pool mostly to see Starfire in a bikini).

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x12
episodes_data.description: Beast Boy turns into a loud, obnoxious gorilla and refuses to change back driving Robin crazy. Gorilla Beast Boy takes over the leadership of the Titans leading to chaos ranging from not letting a girl get onto Beast Boy's monkey bars, fighting crocodiles, and freeing captive gorillas from the zoo. Cyborg teaches Robin how to be an alpha male so he can take back his role as leader of the Teen Titans.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x13
episodes_data.description: When Robin, Cyborg, and Beast Boy won’t let Starfire and Raven come along on their "Boys' Night Out," Starfire and Raven spring Jinx from prison and the three of them have a wild night of their own.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x14
episodes_data.description: Beast Boy's behavior causes him to be fired from the Teen Titans and replaced by a pair of shape-shifting twins.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x15
episodes_data.description: Envious of the other Titans' superpowers following their fight with the H.I.V.E. Five (consisting of Mammoth, Gizmo, Jinx, Billy Numerous, and See-More), Robin wants some of his own. After a disastrous scientific experiment goes awry that merges him with the DNA of the American Robin, he convinces Raven to use her magic to give him superpowers even though she claims that superpowers are a curse.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x16
episodes_data.description: Cyborg plugs into the control panel of the Titans tower and drives the others crazy.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x17
episodes_data.description: Starfire's new pet is a horribly dangerous parasite, but Robin is the only one who is suspicious of the beast.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x18
episodes_data.description: Beast Boy teaches Starfire how to lie and it backfires as her lies get more and more outrageous.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x19
episodes_data.description: Raven eats a bad meatball that causes tentacles to spring from her teeth and devour the other Titans.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x20
episodes_data.description: When Robin's long bo-staff is accidentally broken by the other four Titans, he seeks a new one at the mystical Tree of the Universe.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x21
episodes_data.description: When Beast Boy believes that Terra is his new beloved sweetheart and girlfriend, Raven is suspicious of her true motives.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x22
episodes_data.description: The Titans believe they will win an upcoming dodgeball championship.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x23
episodes_data.description: Cyborg and Beast Boy are in perfect sync, except when it comes to their taste in food. What’s the best food ever created, burgers or burritos? The two friends have an all-out competition to settle things once and for all.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x24
episodes_data.description: Cyborg’s Love Matcher 5000 program pairs Raven with Beast Boy and Starfire with Aquaman. While Beast Boy does everything he can to get Raven to love him, Robin tries to be more like Aquaman to win Starfire’s heart.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x25
episodes_data.description: A magical prism causes Raven to fragment into five distinct personalities which wreak havoc around town until the other Titans can figure out how to rejoin her.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 1x26
episodes_data.description: When the gang bands together to form a giant robot, Robin is relegated to the left leg, but he makes the left leg count!

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x1
episodes_data.description: Blackfire pays a surprise visit to her sister Starfire, saying she wants to spend some quality time with her. The other Titans think that Blackfire is playing another trick, but Starfire is sure that this time Blackfire is serious about reviving their sisterly love

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x2
episodes_data.description: Despite the Titans' protests, Beast Boy becomes convinced that replacing his body parts with robotic limbs makes him more manly.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x3
episodes_data.description: Aqualad asks Raven out on a date, which makes Beast Boy jealous. Cyborg tries to prove that Aqualad is really a pirate.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x4
episodes_data.description: When Robin starts a smear campaign against all of the other Titans so that he can be re-elected  Team Leader, Raven uses a time machine to bring a great leader from the past to teach Robin how to lead.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x5
episodes_data.description: Robin brings Starfire on a fake stakeout in an attempt to get a kiss, while Cyborg and Beast Boy hold their own stakeout to discover Raven's dark secret.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x6
episodes_data.description: When the Brain captures the Titans to fuel Project B.R.I.A.N., the Titans' little buddies are the only heroes who can save them.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x7
episodes_data.description: When Beast Boy loses his ability to change into animals, he realizes that he’s lost touch with his wild side. He goes to the forest to reconnect with his inner beast, but Mother Nature isn't as great as he had hoped.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x8
episodes_data.description: Raven is delighted when the other Titans are magically turned into old people during a battle.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x9
episodes_data.description: Starfire wants to learn more, but will knowledge make her a bummer?

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x10
episodes_data.description: When the other Titans find out that Cyborg is afraid of the dark, they have a slumber party to help him face his fears.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x11
episodes_data.description: Raven warns the Titans not to go near a box containing the Twin Destroyers of Azarath. Starfire can't help it and opens the box, giving hugs and snuggles to the tiny and adorable destroyers... but love only makes the destroyers stronger. Now, the Titans must find a way to get the monsters back in the box before Raven finds out that they were released.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x12
episodes_data.description: Robin has been hiding something under his gloves.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x13
episodes_data.description: Raven and Starfire clash after Starfire creates a bond with Raven's father, while Robin, Cyborg, and Beast Boy struggle to return to Earth's surface after falling into a deep cavern.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x14
episodes_data.description: Robin's perfect sandwich is missing and he will stop at nothing to find it.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x15
episodes_data.description: When Control Freak imprisons the Titans in a Pretty Pretty Pegasus world, the Titans decide to use violence to escape, while Raven decides to use friendship and happiness.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x16
episodes_data.description: When the team tries to live a vegetarian lifestyle, they learn that living that way is not for everyone.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x17
episodes_data.description: Robin's mask hides both his secret identity and a horrible secret.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x18
episodes_data.description: When Robin rations bathroom time to five minutes per visit, the other Titans try to show him the magic of the bathroom.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x19
episodes_data.description: Raven tries to get the other titans to enjoy Halloween again.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x20
episodes_data.description: The Titans compete against each other to prove who is the better gender.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x21
episodes_data.description: Cyborg is infected with a cold and the Titans shrink down to fight it off.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x22
episodes_data.description: Cyborg completely rebuilt the T-Car and takes it out on a road trip.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x23
episodes_data.description: When Raven’s father Trigon shows up for Thanksgiving dinner, Robin’s seating plan isn't the only thing that gets ruined.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x24
episodes_data.description: Due to the Titans' laziness, Robin creates another team of himself to battle Brother Blood.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x25
episodes_data.description: Robin wants to gain the power of whistling.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 2x26
episodes_data.description: The Titans try to convince Beast Boy to clean his room, but they learn that there is more to garbage than just trash.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x1
episodes_data.description: Robin is determined to become a cat in order to get Starfire's attention.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x2
episodes_data.description: After a humiliating defeat, Raven and the Titans work on building their lower body strength, becoming the "League of Legs."

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x3
episodes_data.description: After Beast Boy gets money from the Tooth Fairy, the other Titans try to get in on the action by knocking out their own teeth.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x4
episodes_data.description: After learning looks don't matter, Beast Boy undergoes a metamorphosis through a cocoon, becoming an ugly, gross creature.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x5
episodes_data.description: Having grown sick of Robin's bland cooking, the other Titans make attempts to spice things up.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x6
episodes_data.description: Stuck inside on a rainy day, the Titans do rainy-day activities to keep from boredom.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x7
episodes_data.description: When Robin decides to become an all-American class president-type person, he convinces the Titans to return to school with him.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x8
episodes_data.description: Robin refuses to give the Titans any more orders so that they'll learn to think for themselves.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x9
episodes_data.description: Control Freak informs the Titans that they are on a TV show he created and demands they earn him an award.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x10
episodes_data.description: Cyborg's real strength comes not from his robot parts, but from his favorite song.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x11
episodes_data.description: Robin tries to teach the Titans valuable life lessons by reading them fairytales, but the others co-opt his stories and spin them into their own twisted yarns.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x12
episodes_data.description: The titans are brought to court for the destruction they caused to Jump City.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x13
episodes_data.description: The Hive succeed in destroying the Titans, but their ghosts come back to haunt them all.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x14
episodes_data.description: Beast Boy's presses the fire button on Cyborg's laser cannon and the Titans die, but Beast Boy puts his blood in them to save them from dying and now have the ability to transform into animals and act like animals.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x15
episodes_data.description: It's Beast Boy's birthday, but no one will celebrate it.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x16
episodes_data.description: After refusing to shop on Black Friday, Starfire is visited by the ghosts of Black Friday past, present, and future.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x17
episodes_data.description: The Titans visit the Hall of Justice to use the pool, but then decided to check out the inside.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x18

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x19
episodes_data.description: The Titans attempt to infiltrate Santa's workshop to get their names taken off the Naughty List.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x20
episodes_data.description: The Titans learn about cartoon-style violence while trying to get back a bowl of nuts from a Sqirrel.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x21
episodes_data.description: Robin makes the other Titans sell their treasured mementos from past episodes.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x22
episodes_data.description: Cyborg is building stress up, to the point where he directs his built-up rage onto the other Titans. To help calm him down, Starfire takes Cyborg into her own, little secret garden.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x23
episodes_data.description: The Titans go to watch Lebron James at the Wacka Doodles Amusement Park, but find no one is there.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x24
episodes_data.description: It's Valentine's Day and Cyborg goes to great lengths to make it special for his girlfriend Jinx.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x25
episodes_data.description: Beast Boy makes lots of money due to a pyramid scheme and convinces the other Titans to join in.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 3x26
episodes_data.description: Beast Boy pinches the other Titans on St. Patty's Day, making them pinch him back, resulting in them all getting curse with bad luck.

episodes_data.title: Teen Titans Go! 4x17

episodes_data.description: Robin learns that avocados are a super food that can give you super powers.
